MOA: attract & hold (osmosis) H2O in intestinal lumen → ↑intraluminal P → distends bowel & ↑intestinal activity

Clin Use: peds funct constipation persisting despite first-line → sodium phosphate enema in ED if >2y
Drug Interactions: Certain QT prolonging drugs
